title: Terms of Use
body:
### 1. Acceptance of terms

By accessing or using Thailand Field Notes, visitors agree to use the site responsibly and in accordance with these Terms of Use. If a visitor does not agree, they should not use the site.

### 2. What this site provides

Thailand Field Notes provides general travel guides, route ideas, destination explainers, arrival information, transport guidance, and cultural context for people planning independent travel in Thailand.

### 3. Informational content only

The site is not a travel agency, booking service, immigration authority, emergency service, insurer, or professional adviser. Entry rules, transport schedules, weather, prices, safety conditions, and availability can change. Readers should verify important information with current official or provider sources before acting.

### 4. Acceptable use

Users must not misuse the site, interfere with its operation or security, attempt unauthorized access, overload its systems, use it for unlawful or harmful purposes, or copy and commercially exploit substantial portions of its content without permission.

### 5. Intellectual property

Text, design, organization, images, graphics, branding, and other site materials may be protected by copyright, trademark, or other rights. Visitors may read and share links for personal, non-commercial use unless a page states otherwise. Third-party names and marks remain the property of their respective owners.

### 6. Third-party links and resources

The site may link to external websites, official agencies, providers, products, platforms, or resources. Thailand Field Notes is not responsible for their content, policies, availability, pricing, claims, or actions.

### 7. Advertising, affiliate links, and sponsorships

Google advertising and Google AdSense are not currently active on this site. Affiliate links and sponsorships are also not currently active. If any of these features are introduced, the relevant disclosures and policies will need to be updated before or when they are used.

### 8. No guarantees

The site is provided on an “as available” basis. Content may contain errors, become outdated, or not fit every reader’s circumstances. No particular travel outcome is promised.

### 9. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Thailand Field Notes is not responsible for losses or damages arising from use of the site, reliance on content, third-party links, technical interruptions, or actions taken based on information found on the site.

### 10. Changes to the site or terms

Content, features, pages, links, and these terms may be updated, reorganized, corrected, or removed over time.

### 11. Contact

Thailand Field Notes currently provides no direct contact form or public email address. Readers cannot submit messages through the site. Time-sensitive travel questions should be directed to the relevant official authority or service provider.

title: Privacy Policy
body:
### 1. Introduction

Thailand Field Notes respects reader privacy. This Privacy Policy describes the information that may be processed when visitors use this informational travel site and the services that are currently active.

### 2. Google Analytics is active

Google Analytics is active on Thailand Field Notes under measurement ID G-WPY4ST0YRH. It is used to understand aggregate traffic, page usage, referral patterns, and site performance so the editorial team can maintain and improve the site.

### 3. Technical and usage data

Google Analytics and the site’s hosting or security providers may process technical and usage information. This can include browser and device type, operating system, language, pages viewed, referring page or campaign information, interaction events, timestamps, approximate location derived from an IP address, and technical or security events. Google Analytics may also assign identifiers that help distinguish visits or sessions. Thailand Field Notes does not provide accounts, memberships, comments, user profiles, payments, contact submissions, or other user-submitted content.

### 4. Cookies and similar technologies

Google Analytics may use first-party cookies or similar technologies, where permitted by browser settings and the applicable service configuration, to distinguish visits, measure interactions, and produce usage reports. Hosting and security services may also use necessary technical mechanisms to deliver and protect the site.

### 5. How information is used

Technical and usage information may be used to operate and secure the site, understand which pages are used, improve content and performance, detect abuse, and investigate technical failures. Thailand Field Notes does not use this information to make travel, immigration, insurance, medical, legal, or other high-stakes decisions about individual visitors.

### 6. Google and other third-party processing

Google processes Google Analytics data under its own terms and privacy practices. Hosting, delivery, and security providers may also process information needed to serve and protect the site. These providers may process information in countries other than the visitor’s own. External websites linked from Thailand Field Notes follow their own privacy policies.

### 7. Advertising, AdSense, affiliate links, and sponsorships

Google advertising and Google AdSense are not currently active on Thailand Field Notes. The site does not currently display AdSense ads or use Google advertising features. Affiliate links and sponsorships are also not currently active. Publishing an ads.txt record does not by itself activate advertising or cause ads to be displayed. This policy must be reviewed before advertising or other commercial tracking features are enabled.

### 8. User choices

Visitors can block or delete cookies through browser settings, use browser privacy controls, or use the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on where it is available. Blocking cookies or similar technologies may change how measurement works but should not prevent access to the site’s public articles. Visitors should review Google’s privacy information and the policies of linked third-party services when deciding whether to use them.

### 9. Sharing, retention, and legal disclosures

Information may be processed by the service providers described above and may be disclosed when reasonably necessary for security, legal obligations, safety, or a change in site ownership. Thailand Field Notes does not intentionally sell personal information. Retention periods are controlled by the relevant service configuration and provider requirements, and information is kept only for as long as reasonably needed for the stated purposes.

### 10. Children’s privacy

Thailand Field Notes is a general-audience travel information site and is not directed to children or intended to knowingly collect personal information from children.

### 11. Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated when site features, service configurations, or relevant requirements change. The current version will be published on this page.

### 12. Contact

Thailand Field Notes currently provides no direct contact form or public email address. Readers cannot submit privacy requests through the site at this time. Browser and Google Analytics choices described above remain available directly through the relevant browser or Google service.

title: User Agreement
body:
### 1. Agreement to use the site responsibly

By using Thailand Field Notes, users agree to use the site lawfully, respectfully, and in accordance with this User Agreement.

### 2. Purpose of the site

Thailand Field Notes is an informational and editorial travel resource. It helps English-speaking first-time independent travelers plan routes, prepare for arrival, understand transport, and learn about destinations and local context.

### 3. User responsibilities

Users agree to use the site lawfully, respect intellectual property, avoid scraping or attacking the site, avoid republishing content without permission, and verify important information before acting on it. Urgent or high-stakes safety decisions should be checked with qualified or official sources.

### 4. Content reliance

The site provides general travel information, not immigration decisions, emergency guidance, professional legal advice, medical advice, insurance advice, or a guarantee of safety or entry. Readers remain responsible for checking current conditions and deciding what is appropriate for their circumstances.

### 5. Prohibited uses

Users must not interfere with the site or its servers, attempt unauthorized access, use bots or scraping in abusive ways, republish large portions of content without permission, distribute harmful or illegal material, or misrepresent affiliation with Thailand Field Notes.

### 6. Third-party content and links

Users may encounter links to official websites, providers, tools, products, publishers, or other third parties. Users are responsible for reviewing their terms, privacy policies, pricing, claims, and safety information.

### 7. Site changes and availability

The site may update, remove, reorganize, or correct content. Access may be interrupted or unavailable from time to time, and no continuous availability is promised.

### 8. Reporting issues

Thailand Field Notes currently provides no direct contact form or public email address, so readers cannot submit reports through the site. Time-sensitive travel or safety issues should be checked directly with the relevant official authority, emergency service, or service provider.

### 9. Relationship to other policies

This User Agreement should be read together with the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use available through the site footer.

title: About
body:
### What this site is

Thailand Field Notes is a practical travel guide for English-speaking first-time independent visitors who want clearer decisions about traveling in Thailand. It organizes useful information around real planning questions rather than asking readers to sort through an unstructured list of destinations.

### What we cover

The site covers trip length and route planning, entry and arrival basics, local and long-distance transport, destination comparisons, Thai food, and cultural etiquette. Content is arranged through Plan Your Trip, Entry Essentials, Getting Around, and Destinations & Local Context.

### Editorial identity

Thailand Field Notes Editorial Desk is the site-level editorial identity responsible for preparing and reviewing published guidance. It identifies the editorial function of this website, not a named individual, personal credential, travel agency, or claim of first-hand travel experience.

### How we create and review content

Articles are organized around practical reader decisions and reviewed for clarity, internal consistency, useful structure, reference fit, and relevant connections to other pages. We distinguish broad planning suggestions from specific factual or policy claims. Where an official source or primary service provider directly addresses a point, we cite it; a contextual weather or contact link does not verify unrelated food, rail, destination, or entry statements. Some examples are editorial planning suggestions rather than externally verified facts. Readers should check current rules, timetables, opening conditions, and local forecasts with the responsible source before acting. We do not claim that every place, route, service, or experience described has been personally visited or tested.

### Important limitations

Thailand Field Notes provides general travel information. It is not a government tourism authority, travel agency, booking service, immigration adviser, lawyer, doctor, emergency service, or insurance provider. Nothing on the site guarantees entry, safety, availability, pricing, weather, or a particular travel outcome.

### Our reader promise

The editorial desk aims to make planning topics easier to understand, avoid unnecessary jargon, separate practical guidance from unsupported opinion, keep pages readable on mobile, and connect readers to relevant resources when that helps them make a better decision.

### Contact and updates

Thailand Field Notes currently provides no direct contact form or public email address. Readers cannot submit messages or correction requests through the site. Pages may be corrected or updated during editorial review when the site scope or important travel information changes.
